## Appearance

This slender girl possesses a pointed, freckled face with a little pale chin, cheeks that faintly flush pink, and an oval girlish cheek. Her notable eyes are solemn, luminous, and gray, being big and alluring. She has hair that is known as red, auburn, or [Titian](../character/titian.md), which she has worn in long braids, unbraided streaming in brightness, and cropped short into silky curls or shingled closely. At times her hair has even turned green, and its loosened rings curl around her neck and forehead.

## Personality

Driven by an intense motivation to excel academically and add beauty to life, she strives to be a teacher and attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) while avoiding any strain on Marilla's savings. She possesses a remarkably imaginative, passionate, and romantic spirit, though her heedless and impulsive nature frequently leads to daydreaming. Characterized as smart, loyal, and strong-willed, she takes matters seriously and is prone to soaring high in anticipation before crashing into despair. Her notable skills include storytelling, writing sketches, singing, and possessing a natural knack for handling children. Alongside her ambition to succeed before her peer [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), she holds a firm opposition to corporal punishment. However, her vast imagination leaves her terrified of facing the [Haunted Wood](../codex/places.md#haunted-wood) after dark.

## History

Born in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), Anne Shirley spent her early years as an orphan living with Mrs. [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md), Mrs. [Hammond](../character/hammond.md), and at an asylum before being brought to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) by [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). Although [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) initially intended to send her back because they had requested a boy, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) ultimately decided to keep and raise her. Anne quickly formed a deep bond with [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) and entered a fierce academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) after he pulled her braid at school. After completing her studies at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) and winning the Avery scholarship, Anne chose to forfeit the scholarship to stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and teach locally after [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) died and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) faced failing eyesight. During her time teaching, she joined with friends to organize the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), unintentionally sold her neighbor Mr. Harrison's cow before befriending him, and took in the orphaned Keith twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Later, Anne attended [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport), renting a house named Patty's Place with her friends and [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), and inherited a thousand dollars from Miss [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md). Throughout her college years, she refused proposals from [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md), [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md), and [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), and initially turned down [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) before realizing her true feelings for him. After returning home following graduation, Anne visited [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) Gray's garden with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), where she accepted his proposal of marriage.

## Quotes

> "Pretty well. I imagine a good deal, and that helps to pass the time. Of course, it’s rather lonesome. But then, I may as well get used to that."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P11](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0011)

> "I don’t get cross about other things; but I’m so tired of being twitted about my hair and it just makes me boil right over. Do you suppose my hair will really be a handsome auburn when I grow up?"
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P43](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0043)

> "I love pretty things; and I hate to look in the glass and see something that isn’t pretty. It makes me feel so sorrowful—just as I feel when I look at any ugly thing. I pity it because it isn’t beautiful."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P45](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0045)

> "I love Green Gables already, and I never loved any place before. No place ever seemed like home. Oh, Marilla, I’m so happy. I could pray right now and not find it a bit hard."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P49](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0049)

> "Oh, Marilla, I’m frightened—now that it has come I’m actually frightened. What if she shouldn’t like me! It would be the most tragical disappointment of my life."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P10](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0010)

## Relationships

### [Bertha Shirley](../character/bertha-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--bertha-shirley.md)

[Bertha Shirley](../character/bertha-shirley.md) is Anne's late mother. During a stay in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), Anne visits her birthplace where she receives a packet of her parents' old letters, allowing her to feel a true connection and understanding toward them for the first time.

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana-barry.md)

[Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) is Anne's devoted bosom friend and playmate, bound by a solemn oath of eternal friendship made shortly after they first met. Their close bond has weathered several dramatic trials, including a temporary ban by Diana's mother that was lifted after Anne saved Diana's little sister from croup. They continue to share school days, creative ventures, and deep personal milestones together.

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

Anne and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) began as bitter academic rivals and enemies after he pulled her braid and called her 'Carrots,' leading her to hold a persistent grudge despite his attempts to apologize and even rescue her from a sinking boat. Over time, her hostility dissolved into secret regret and forgiveness, and they eventually grew into close friends and newspaper collaborators. Although [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) harbors romantic feelings for her, Anne's focus remains on their friendship and shared academic life.
